summary: Recommends using fully qualified collection names, including the ansible.builtin prefix for built-in modules like ansible.builtin.copy.
questions: Should I write copy or ansible.builtin.copy?
Why should I use FQCNs in tasks?
What prefix do built-in modules use?

answer_card.title: Use fully qualified collection names
answer_card.answer_md: Use FQCNs so Ansible doesn't have to guess which collection a module or plugin comes from. For built-in modules and plugins, prefix with `ansible.builtin`, e.g. `ansible.builtin.copy`.
